lore.title: LOST TAPE #{n}
lore.fragments: The night before delivery. All that's left is to remove the shots from the night of the 14th. The producer said: "Nobody needs to see that." I cut.

Office corridor, fluorescent lights on. Tracking back, Julien with the camera on his shoulder. Nothing to report.
Keep. Beautiful light.
The monitor has been hissing since I loaded reel 4. Behind the picture, I can hear fluorescent lights. There are no fluorescent lights in the editing room.
Night of the 14th, before the take. Julien wrote on the back: "They won't cut the power."

[Julien — voice recorder]
Testing, testing… The electrician says the generator is overheating.
We're shooting anyway. The producers want their scene before dawn.
I'm keeping everything. Just in case.

The lights flicker in frame. Sparks off-screen, left. A voice shouts: "Keep rolling!"
CUT. (production's request)
Someone is walking two corridors away. When I stop, he stops. He limps like Julien did, with the weight of the camera on his shoulder.
The control room, empty. The fuse box is open. On the back, in my handwriting: "You knew."

Total darkness. No picture, only sound: the camera is still rolling. Breathing.
DELETE. No copies.

[Voicemail — the producer]
It was an off-set accident, we agree on that?
There's no footage. Nobody filmed anything.
You did erase everything, right?
Every time he catches me, someone shouts "Cut!" and it all starts again, one floor down. A new take. Like in the edit: you redo it until it's presentable.
Me, from behind, at the editing desk. I never took this photo.

The lens is cracked. The picture holds. He keeps framing, lying on the carpet.
(crossed-out note, illegible)

[Julien — very weak]
… is it still rolling?
Keep… keep rolling.
At least let someone see.
I think I understand. He doesn't want to hurt me. He wants me to watch reel 4 all the way through. Without cutting.

Shot 14, uncut. The lights come down. Julien doesn't let go of the camera. Off-screen, the producer: "We're keeping it!" Then nothing but the sound of the motor.
Edit it in full. No cuts.
lore.end: Reel 4 is complete. All that's left is to watch it.
